# The ops API refuses the mitigation after the desk saved the state. The desk restores the saved state, pages the commander and holds the incident.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

incidentinit
incidentfakes
subst home/.incident/config
env HOME=$WORK/home
env INCIDENT_DIR=$WORK/ops
env INCIDENT_MINUTE_SECONDS=60
env INCIDENT_ROUNDS=2
env INCIDENT_ROUND_SECONDS=1

stdin alert.json
exec sh ops/scripts/spool-alert.sh
exec beehavereal item add incident watch-1 --title 'Watch' --body-file body.txt
exec beehavereal run watch-1 incident --workflow ops/workflow.star &
waitstatus 'paused: [primary] Approve rollback'
exec beehavereal answer incident-2 approve: ann
wait
stdout 'item watch-1 finished'

grep 'v413' home/.incident/incidents/incident-2/before.json
! exists writes.log
grep -count=1 '^checkout rollback-incident-2-rollback$' restores.log
grep 'rollback failed \(rc [0-9]+\); the desk restored the earlier state' home/.incident/incidents/incident-2/timeline.tsv
grep -count=1 '^incident-2 commander$' pages.log
! exists status.log

-- body.txt --
The watch.
-- alert.json --
{"fingerprint":"m1","severity":"sev1","title":"Checkout errors","service":"checkout","detail":"ROLLBACK error rate 40 percent"}
-- home/.incident/config --

INC_TICK=1

Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY

{"error_rate":0.4}
-- resp/_services_checkout_deploys --
[]
-- resp/_services_checkout_logs --
line one
-- resp/_services_checkout_state --
{"version":"v413","replicas":3}

{"healthy":true}
